_note: MEASURED LIVE, and the modal is REACHED the way a user reaches it: rail ->
`b` -> Starters -> apply `Stripe Blue` -> the footer's own Save. Nothing is
probed and no state is faked; the nine diff rows are the starter's nine colour
tokens as the registry staged them.
WHAT THE BOARD WON:
title        16px (1172:4841). It shipped at 13 — the same size as the row
labels under it — so the dialog had no heading, only a first
line. See the finding below about WHY 13 never even applied.
diff row     `--color/bg-subtle` on a 10px gap and a 10/6 inset, radius 6
(1172:4842). It sat on `--bk-gray-50`, a step lighter, which on
a white dialog left the rows with almost no plate; and the
colour rows added `py-2` on top of the shared row class, so the

all three buttons  12/7 inset, radius 6, 13px labels (1172:4859..4864);
`Discard all` white on a `--color/error` edge, `Keep editing`
white on `--color/border`, `Apply N changes` filled
`--color/accent`. All three were pinned to `h-7` with 11px
labels — the PANEL's row size applied to a dialog's actions,
which is where boards.json's "buttons 32h vs 27" came from.
boards.json's other half, "360w vs board 520", is already
fixed: ModalContent's `md` is `w-[520px]` and cites this board.
CONTRAST — CONFORMING THE FILL INTRODUCED EIGHTEEN FAILURES AND THEY WERE NOT
BASELINED. Moving the row from `--bk-gray-50` to the board's
`--color/bg-subtle` dropped `--bk-ink-muted` from 4.66:1 to 4.39:1, under the
AA floor, on both the struck-through old value and the `->` between the two —
nine rows x two nodes = 18, every one of them reported by measure.mjs the
moment the fill landed. The fill is the board's and stays; the TEXT moves to
`--bk-ink-soft` (6.5:1), which is the substitution DesignTabFooter and the
Beginner note already document for this exact pair, and the systemic defect
recorded in docs/design-jobs/FIGMA-TO-CODE/CONTRAST-INK-MUTED.md. That means
1172:4845 / 4849 / 4853 are NOT joined: the board names ink-muted there and a
board cannot authorise a contrast failure.
FOUND AND FIXED, worth carrying to whoever owns chrome-ui: a caller CANNOT set
a ModalTitle's font size through `className`. `MODAL_TITLE_CLASS` is
`text-[length:var(--bk-text-14)]`, the caller's is a second arbitrary
font-size utility on a plain <h2>, and two classes on one property resolve by
STYLESHEET order — so this file's `tw:text-[13px]` had no effect and the
heading measured 14 the whole time it claimed 13. The size now lives on a span
inside the heading, which is also what the recipe anchors. ModalTitle already
carries an `inset` escape hatch for the identical problem on padding; a `size`
prop would close the other half.
